description: Comprehensive Node & Pod resource monitoring for EKS cluster running Vendure e-commerce platform

panels.title: Pod Resource Requests vs Limits vs Actual
CPU: Requests vs Limits vs Actual by Namespace
Memory: Requests vs Limits vs Actual by Namespace

targets.expr: sum by (pod, namespace) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!="", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) / sum by (pod, namespace) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!="", namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) * 100 > 0

sum by (pod, namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / sum by (pod, namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", namespace=~"$namespace"}) * 100 > 0

title: Node & Pod Resources
